name: Health
description: Server smoke test. Run before the E2E: if `embedding_status` is not `ready`, ingest and search fail or hang.

exec: pm.expect(embedding, 'warming = model still loading/downloading; error = load failed, check the server logs').to.eql('ready');

request.description:
Returns `{"status": "ok", "embedding_status": "warming|ready|error"}`.

`status` is `ok` as soon as the port is open; `embedding_status` reflects the loading of the embedding model, which starts in the background at startup (on first boot it downloads the model from Hugging Face, which can take a while).

The value is saved in the `embedding_status` variable.
